005package org.wpilib.util;
006
007/** Utility class for common WPILib error messages. */
008public final class ErrorMessages {
009  /** Utility class, so constructor is private. */
010  private ErrorMessages() {
011    throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This is a utility class!");
012  }
013
014  /**
015   * Requires that a parameter of a method not be null; prints an error message with helpful
016   * debugging instructions if the parameter is null.
017   *
018   * @param <T> Type of object.
019   * @param obj The parameter that must not be null.
020   * @param paramName The name of the parameter.
021   * @param methodName The name of the method.
022   * @return The object parameter confirmed not to be null.
023   */
024  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidThrowingNullPointerException")
025  public static <T> T requireNonNullParam(T obj, String paramName, String methodName) {
026    if (obj == null) {
027      throw new NullPointerException(
028          "Parameter "
029              + paramName
030              + " in method "
031              + methodName
032              + " was null when it should not have been!  Check the stacktrace to find the"
033              + " responsible line of code - usually, it is the first line of user-written code"
034              + " indicated in the stacktrace.  Make sure all objects passed to the method in"
035              + " question were properly initialized - note that this may not be obvious if it"
036              + " is being called under dynamically-changing conditions!  Please do not seek"
037              + " additional technical assistance without doing this first!");
038    }
039    return obj;
040  }
041}
